Daily Devotional

November 29

7 Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you: (Matthew 7:7 KJV)

This verse is not guaranteeing us everything we might ever desire. It must be taken in context with the rest of the scriptures. This verse tells us to do three things, ask, seek and knock. First of all we have to ask in accordance to God’s will. James tells us that we ask and receive not, because we ask amiss, to consume it on ourselves (James 4:3), so this shows us that we have to ask properly. This asking is not pleading with God for something, but asking God to give us what He has already provided by His Grace, the same as we would say “pass the butter please” at dinner. It is a polite demand for something that is made available to us.

The seeking needs also to be in accordance with God’s will, and the bible teaches that we need to seek with all our hearts, in order to find (Jeremiah 29:13), so it is not enough to just seek in a carnal way. God will help us find His will for our lives and everything else that is to our benefit, and in accordance to what the Word says. You must be willing to seek with your heart for the purpose of benefiting others, and not just seeking to fulfill your own lusts.

Knocking and it will be opened to you, includes asking for salvation (Romans 10:9-10) and many other things, including the baptism of the Holy Ghost. God will not deny us all the benefits that He has for us, but it is up to us to knock, as well as to ask and seek. God has provided many blessings in the atonement of Jesus, but it is up to us to reach out and take the blessings that are ours, such as healing, deliverance, prosperity, etc. Do these things in accordance with God’s Word and you will receive. Thank you Lord for all your promises!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
